{{Quote|The disciplines of Mind require intense concentration and are mentally taxing. Physical strength will not help you here, only psychic clarity.|[[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], ''[[Book of Sith]]''|<ref name="Book of Sith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
'''Mind''' was the third school, or focus, taught by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The Sith channeled the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] for the [[Force power/Legends|disciplines]] of Mind, which drew from the [[Unifying Force/Legends|unifying Force]] and operated in the realm of thought and memory rather than the physical plane; thus, they required psychic strength rather than physical. [[Crucitorn (technique)|Crucitorn]], [[Hatred]], [[Mind trick/Legends|Horror]], [[Memory Walk]], and [[Mind Shard]] were associated with Mind.<ref name="Book of Sith" />
